notes.title: "Paradise on the Nile" Sale - 25% off Riddle of the Sphinx™
notes.content:
With this discounted pricing, now is the time to immerse yourself into the Giza Sphinx and Great Pyramid — one of the last seven wonders of the ancient world — and solve a Riddle of megalithic proportions.

And along the way, you will be able to enjoy Paradise on the Nile!

This is your chance to explore secret chambers, discover hidden tombs, unearth ancient relics, and unravel an ancient Riddle, entombed for centuries by the ancient Egyptians!

Beautifully rendered 3D environments and scenes with meticulous attention to detail
Cinematic animations and cut-scenes throughout the game
Historical accuracy and real-world archaeological puzzle integration
An original, richly orchestrated Egyptian soundtrack
Over 50 million square feet of exploration

The Enhanced Edition Engine features:
HD resolution: every element has been HD enhanced
Exceedingly fast navigation
Cinematic transitions & node warping

A robust interactive in-game hint & solutions guide: Book of the Dead Ends™ unlocked for the Sphinx Plateau and Great Pyramid
Re-engineered Inventory and Saved Games UI


Don't wait. This sale won't last forever!

notes.title: Mega Mummy Update & Lower DLC Prices
notes.content:
This Mummy Madness Update unwraps major game enhancements, updates, and new lower DLC prices! With the lower pricing, save up 30-40% off DCLs.

Plus, we have optimized gameplay along with addressing a few known issues, along with some rare bugs. And we have further optimized the audio mixing.

Fixes:


 The robot puzzle has been wholly reprogrammed for the few that seemed to run into issues with the HAP codec.
 The music levels have been further normalized and adjusted.
 The quit video audio has been reduced (WIN only today; MAC in a few days)
 Fixed AGE key inventory bugs.
 Optimized navigation is several areas.
 Added no-click zones in certain areas to aid in exploration.
 ... and many more!

notes.content:

This is your chance to unlock :


the full, enhanced edition of Riddle of the Sphinx™ The Awakening

the interactive in-game hints and solutions guide DLC, Book of the Dead Ends™
Gil's Secret Library DLC (coming soon)
and the ROTS Awakening Digital Soundtrack composed and performed by ROTS co-creator, Jeff Tobler.

notes.title: POWER-UPdate (1.0r3) released!
notes.content:
We've made several improvements to the Robot puzzle and ITV, plus much more...

We listened and made the robot faster with a variable speed throttle/toggle. The heaviest particles in the game (dust) have been optimized for older/slower computers. Many other enhancements have been made, plus we fixed a few things that needed fixing!

As an added bonus, we have also unlocked the Book of the Dead Ends™ trial to include full access to all hints and solutions at:

the Sphinx Plateau
Gil's Tent
the Great Pyramid necropolis (outside areas of Cheops)
the Ascending Passageway
the Descending Passageway
the Grand Gallery
the Queen's Chamber
and the King's Chamber.

This will allow players more access to hints and solutions in the crucial beginnings of the game and get a good feel for how the in-game hints system works.

Details below:


Optimization of ITV toggles, allow for faster navigation of Cheoptronic.
Added animation of cull dispenser without sand cull.
Fixed issue of Tomb Door sometimes showing incorrectly.
Fixed ITV if loading back into ITV.
Fixed ITV autoretrieval issues for unique scenarios.
Optimized ITV monitor.
Fixed Funerary Yacht columns holding states after quitting or leaving the scene.
Fixed fire in Funerary Yacht chamber.
Fixed occasional camera issues
Fixed taking photos over scrapbook.
Fixed match accidentally placing into backpack.
Intro videos can now be skipped after the first time through. Videos cannot be skipped the first time game is played.
Fixed persistent ambient sound effects playing on certain loaded games.
Misc. Book of the Dead Ends™ revisions, fixes, and expansion, including missing schematics and images.
Reverted music to original in Tomb, King's Chamber, and Grand Gallery.

notes.title: Paw Patch (1.0r2) is available!
notes.content:
Paw Patch recommended for immediate update.
This is a major patch for both Mac and Win builds that resolves many small and few larger issues affecting gameplay and UI interaction. We encourage you to update to Paw Patch for the best adventure experience. And we will continue to quickly address issues as they come to our attention. THANK YOU to everyone who contributed and/or reported these issues.

While not everyone experienced most of the following issues, they were either reported by users (and verified) or discovered by the dev team:

Change log:

Gameplay:

 Fixed soft locks (covers several reported soft locks/freezes)
 Fixed premature Cheoptronic auto-retrieval
 Fixed RaPyr door zoom/soft lock
 Fixed DLC panels lock/unlock status (infrequent)
 Fixed right-click turning pages in books
 Fixed hiding of notebook when taking photos
 Fixed Chamber of Ages navigation issue after solving (rare)
 Refined Chamber of Ages keys behavior
 Refined sand ramp access from Tent near Great Pyramid
 Fixed click-thru at Starwall in Astrological Chamber
 Fixed New Game clean-up of previous gameplay settings


Graphical:

 Fixed rendering anomalies in Temple Landscape
 Fixed Bible version
 Fixed Psalms page rendering in Bible


Enhancements:

 Added sound to sand cull filling
 Added sound to airshaft 'door'
 Added "Entombed" music to Tomb chamber, as in original
 Lengthened Festive flute playing time
 Refined ITV toggles
 Expanded Advanced Settings options
 Improved Loupe functionality


Known Issues:

 Some Windows 7 users experience a black flash and crash upon start up. We have a test build in the works that we hope to upload shortly.

notes.title: Riddle of the Sphinx™ The Awakening is LIVE!
notes.content:
Immerse yourself into the Giza Sphinx and Great Pyramid — one of the last seven wonders of the ancient world — and solve a Riddle of megalithic proportions. 

Riddle of the Sphinx™ is truly an epic ancient Egyptian adventure featuring exploration in and around highly accurate 3d replicas of the Giza Sphinx and Great Pyramid of Cheops (aka, Khufu). While you start out at the Sphinx and can examine the inside of the Great Pyramid as it exists today, this is only the beginning of a long journey that reveals and solves many real-life archaeological mysteries. 

You will be the one to make these exciting finds, and ultimately solve the Riddle of the Sphinx™! But you must be careful. Your choices matter. The ancient Egyptians went to great lengths to keep others from finding the secrets and solving the Riddle.

Decode ancient puzzles designed to thwart 4,500-year-old tomb robbers. And explore secret chambers, discover hidden tombs, unearth ancient relics, and unravel an ancient Riddle, entombed for centuries by the ancient Egyptians!

Riddle of the Sphinx™ features:

Hours of challenging game play
Complex puzzles and subtly hidden clues to challenge your skills
Beautifully rendered 3D environments scenes with meticulous attention to detail
An original, richly orchestrated Egyptian soundtrack
Over 50 million square feet of exploration
Real-time environmental effects
In-game Bool of the Dead Ends™ Hints & Solutions (sold separately)
